findings.title: reviewCallSpawnOptions validated one value but computed from the raw argument
findings.action: Compute from the validated secs and test a digit-string input
findings.disposition_rationale: e49c625a computes from positiveInt(deadlineSecs); reviewCallSpawnOptions("300") now gives 330000 and is tested.

findings.title: dispatchJudgeRulings header omitted the new required clock dep
findings.disposition_rationale: e49c625a lists backendsChain and clock and notes cmdAssemble sets clock.

findings.title: Misaligned comment column in the build_judge example
Direct callers of dispatchOne that omit clock get a TypeError
findings.disposition_rationale: The only in-tree caller (cmdAssemble) always sets clock, the header now documents it, and the failure is loud (exit 2), never a silent admit.

findings.title: A deadline above about 24.8 days overflows the execFileSync timeout and parks with exit 1
findings.disposition_rationale: Only reachable by an absurd operator setting; the outcome is a park (fail-safe), not a hang.

findings.title: ETIMEDOUT stderr line could print an undefined deadline
findings.disposition_rationale: Unreachable: without deadlineSecs no spawn timeout is armed, so execFileSync never raises ETIMEDOUT; cosmetic only.
